question: Can a distinct future reader recognize the existing consecutive-prone completion rule while preserving every original R10O publication and criterion?

selected_change.prone_completion: Use the consecutive prone-sample counter required by the actual orchestrator, require its elapsed counter to remain within the original confirmation horizon, retain native complete-phase evidence and the exclusion of partial-recovery packets.
selected_change.no_kick_and_partial_predicates: Unchanged; verify their retained results remain identical.

coverage_adequacy.physical_route_evidence: The R10O pair and single-kick attempt constructed, stepped, finalized, retained and published complete valid physical records on the unchanged V55 route. The phase-243 attempt remains a valid development negative under its original reader.
coverage_adequacy.changed_code_path: Only post-result measurement semantics change at this component stage. The observed defect is independently reproduced from the retained event and counter sequence.
coverage_adequacy.required_new_checks: Fresh zero-world executions of the distinct reader on all three retained R10O reports, with exact source/runtime/input bindings and cold native replay where the production reader requires it; independent boundary and corruption controls cover the changed interpretation.
coverage_adequacy.no_fresh_development_world_for_reader_on: Another physical run adds no coverage of a post-result reader defect when constructor, controller, adapter, stepping, schedule and capture remain byte-exact. Use the existing valid route evidence and separately labeled post-exposure reader validation; do not call the old negative positive.
coverage_adequacy.scope_change_rule: Any change to a physical producer, controller, adapter, stepping, schedule or capture dependency requires a fresh explicit coverage assessment and applicable bounded development smoke before load-bearing physics.

required_zero_world_cases: 14 elapsed / 12 consecutive with native complete recovery is recognized under the existing rule.
12 elapsed / 12 consecutive with native complete recovery remains recognized.
12 elapsed / 10 consecutive is not recognized, even if an elapsed-only check would pass.
Missing, unknown, non-finite, crossed or forged counter/history values are refused.
Confirmation beyond the original 60-step horizon is not recognized.
Incomplete native recovery, incomplete standing evidence or crossed partial/prone populations cannot pass.
The original R10O reader and all original publications retain their exact results.
The no-kick and partial-recovery measurement populations remain unchanged.
Crossed source, runtime, candidate, task or campaign bindings are refused.
ordered_gates: Implement the distinct reader component and permanent counter boundary controls.
Bind and audit fresh post-exposure reader executions on the retained R10O reports without replacing original results.
Declare a new held-out finite decision graph and fresh population only after component validation.
Implement and freeze the complete dependency, preregistration, qualification, execution-authority and campaign graph.
Run complete official qualification at the exact new dependency key, then the single-use fresh held-out decision.
Independently close the decision and explicitly adopt QSDK-R10/M07 only if its prospective acceptance passes.
